summary.text: The Trewartha climate classification is a modified version of the Köppen–Geiger system, first published by American geographer Glenn Thomas Trewartha in 1966.
It keeps Köppen's tropical and polar climates but redefines the middle latitudes to sit closer to vegetation zones and genetic climate systems.
It measures dryness with its own threshold formula, 10(T − 10) + 3P, using mean annual temperature and the share of rain falling in the six high-sun months.

facts.label: Fi locations
facts.value: Frozen Arctic Ocean, Antarctica and Greenland

items.prompt: A town in the interior of Asia has warm summers, but its coldest month averages −8 °C. Which Trewartha type fits it?
items.explain: Continental (Dc) climates have a coldest monthly mean below 0 °C, as in some interior landmasses of Asia and North America.

items.prompt: In a place where every single month averages below freezing, what would the surface look like?

options.label: Tundra shrubs after a short thaw

items.explain: This is Trewartha's Fi type, the region of perpetually frozen ocean and permanent ice plateaus in Antarctica and Greenland.

items.prompt: Two tropical towns: one has a single dry month a year, the other a long dry season in its low-sun months. Which is classed Ar?

options.label: The town with one dry month
The town with the long dry season

items.explain: Ar covers tropical climates with no more than two dry months; a low-sun dry season makes the other Aw.

items.prompt: Why did Trewartha rework Köppen's climate system?

options.label: To add a tropical group Köppen lacked
To replace letter codes with numbers
To fix flaws, mainly in the middle latitudes
To extend the system to the oceans

items.explain: The system was created to answer deficiencies in Köppen–Geiger, chiefly by redefining the middle latitudes.

items.prompt: Two continental (Dc) towns: one's warmest month averages 24 °C, the other's 19 °C. Which one gets the code Dca?
items.explain: Dca is used where the warmest month averages 22.2 °C or more; below that the code is Dcb.

items.prompt: In Trewartha's tropical A climates, every month averages at least 18 °C. How are these climates described?
items.explain: With all 12 months at 18 °C or above, the A climates form the realm of the winterless frost-free zone.
